@dotWt_liftWord : ∀ {ι : Type u_4} {Fq : Type u_5} {K : Type u_6} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Field Fq]
  [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Algebra Fq K] (a f : ι → Fq),
  dotWt (liftWord a) (liftWord f) = (algebraMap Fq K) (dotWt a f)
@satisfies_liftConstraint_iff : ∀ {ι : Type u_4} {Fq : Type u_5} {K : Type u_6} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Field Fq]
  [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Algebra Fq K] (f : ι → Fq) (c : LinearConstraint ι Fq),
  Satisfies (liftWord f) (liftConstraint c) ↔ Satisfies f c
@lifted_constraint_residual : ∀ {ι : Type u_4} {Fq : Type u_5} {K : Type u_6} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Field Fq]
  [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Algebra Fq K] (f : ι → Fq) (c : LinearConstraint ι Fq),
  dotWt (liftConstraint c).wt (liftWord f) - (liftConstraint c).target = (algebraMap Fq K) (dotWt c.wt f - c.target)
@card_lifted_batch_satisfying_le : ∀ {ι : Type u_4} {Fq : Type u_5} {K : Type u_6} [inst : Fintype ι]
  [inst_1 : Field Fq] [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Algebra Fq K] [inst_4 : Fintype K] [inst_5 : DecidableEq K]
  {f : ι → Fq} {cs : List (LinearConstraint ι Fq)},
  (∃ c ∈ cs, ¬Satisfies f c) →
    {γ | Satisfies (liftWord f) (batchConstraint γ (List.map liftConstraint cs))}.card ≤ cs.length - 1
